sections.heading: Description
sections.content: Identify who is affected by the change, how (in terms of impacts) as well as their influence on the implementation of the project. Stakeholder categorization helps tailor communication in a way that is relevant to a particular group. This analysis is a prerequisite for defining change, communication and training strategies.

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Improves stakeholder alignment and support. Enables tailored communication and engagement. Reduces resistance and increases adoption. Enhances collaboration and trust. Supports successful change implementation.
